title: 第150章 偷鸡不成蚀把米第149章 被打了还要供着
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
第一卷第150章偷鸡不成蚀把米
很快，两大一小，便化作流光，往城池下方飞去了。
中洲的城池真的很繁荣。
洛还真在路上的时候，问过花大姐和童大哥，两人解释这些城池只是普通级别的修真小城罢了，在中洲里算不上什么大型城池。
可饶是如此，洛还真入了城，也还是被城池的规模和繁荣程度惊到了——
中洲普普通通的城池，都比东洲的一流城池，还要繁荣兴盛很多啊！
洛还真想，要是东洲也有这样浓郁的灵气，这样繁荣的发展，就好了。
洛还真的心里种下了一颗小小的种子。
但是现在的她不知道的是，多年以后，她所希望的这一切，在她以及万千修士的共同努力下。
真的实现了。
不过这些是后话，暂且不提。
此时此刻，洛还真入了城，就开始拿自己想要吃的东西。
“这个这个，我要这个！”
“这个我也来两个。”
花大姐脸上笑嘻嘻的，她付钱付得心甘情愿。
童大哥也跟在两人的身后，他负责的是将东西全部装起来，收纳进自己的乾坤袋里面。
当然，在收的时候是要做手脚的——将花大姐交给他的昏睡毒悄悄往吃食上面撒。
两个人一个付灵石，一个搞小动作。
洛还真似乎什么都不知道，只管拿自己想吃的。
一开始，花大姐还笑呵呵的。

但是渐渐地，她有点笑不出来了。
“不是，小真真啊。你要这么多，吃得完吗？”
洛还真颔首。
“吃得完的，真真肚皮很大。”
花大姐：“……”
开玩笑的吧。
这些吃的，再来两个十个成年修士，才勉强能吃完吧。
洛还真一个小孩儿，怎么可能吃得下？
而且，她虽然愿意给洛还真买吃食。
可她若是每个城池都这么花她的灵石，花大姐的心里其实是不愿意的。
倒不是付不付得起的问题，而是超出她的预期了。
不过幸好，在花大姐有点快要接受不了灵石的价钱之前，洛还真停了。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 150: Stealing the chicken but losing the rice
Soon, the two, one large and one small, turned into streams of light and flew down the city.
The cities in Middle-earth are really prosperous.
When Luo Huanzhen was on the road, he asked Sister Hua and Brother Tong, and they explained that these cities were just ordinary-level cultivation towns and not considered large cities in Central Continent.
But despite this, when Luo Huan actually entered the city, he was still shocked by the scale and prosperity of the city——
The ordinary cities in Central Continent are much more prosperous than the first-class cities in East Continent!
Luo Huan really thought, it would be great if Dongzhou also had such rich spiritual energy and such prosperous development.
Luo really planted a small seed in his heart.
But what she doesn't know now is that many years later, all she hopes for will be achieved through the joint efforts of her and thousands of monks.
It really came true.
But these are things for later, let’s not mention them for now.
At this moment, Luo Huan really entered the city and started to get what he wanted to eat.
"This, this, I want this!"
"I'll take two of these too."
Sister Hua had a smile on her face, and she paid willingly.
Brother Tong also followed behind the two of them. He was responsible for packing all the things and storing them in his own Qiankun bag.
Of course, he had to do some tricks when collecting it - he secretly sprinkled the sleeping poison that Sister Hua gave him to the food.
One of the two people pays the spirit stone, and the other performs small tricks.
Luo Huanzhen seemed to know nothing and just took what he wanted to eat.
At first, Sister Hua was still laughing.
But gradually, she couldn't laugh anymore.
"No, Xiao Zhenzhen. You want so much, can you finish it?"
Luo Huan nodded.
"You can finish eating, and your belly is really big."
Sister Hua: "..."
Just kidding.
It would take two to ten adult monks to finish the food.
Luo is really just a child, how can he possibly eat it?
Moreover, although she was willing to buy food for Luo Huanzhen.
But if she spends her spiritual stones like this in every city, Sister Hua is actually unwilling to do so.
It wasn't a matter of whether she could afford it, but it was beyond her expectations.
Fortunately, Luo really stopped before Sister Hua almost couldn't accept the price of the spirit stone.
